title: Factory Aisles
event: Overhead panels slide down and floor fixtures unlatch: checkout islands fold into low conveyor modules and the central atrium reconfigures into a narrow industrial corridor. Lighting snaps from warm retail to cold fluorescents and metal tracks click into place along the ceiling, forcing circulation into a single scraped lane.
consequence: A thin streak of dark oil is dragged across the new corridor floor, cutting from the escalator toward the meat cases.
nextHook: oil streak crossing the atrium toward displays
stillPrompt: Wide, high-angle view of the familiar Kaufhaus central atrium transformed into a temporary factory: retail shelving telescopes inward, checkout desks hinge down into metal belts, exposed ceiling tracks and hanging metal panels cast hard shadows. People are tiny, blurred. No signage, no text. Cold fluorescent light throws hard reflections on tile; a fresh dark oil streak runs along the newly formed corridor between escalator and aisle.
videoPrompt: Stable crane shot from the atrium loft. Animate the slow mechanical folding of checkout islands into conveyor modules, the lowering of ceiling panels and the click-and-slide of metal tracks. Convey the rearrangement by pushing the camera forward along the new corridor until the oil streak comes into frame, glinting under harsh lamps. Do not introduce any figures or objects that were not already visible.
cameraCue: After the rearrangement finishes, push the crane down and forward to reveal the oil streak at floor level, then hold.

title: Pulsing Displays
event: Refrigerated display cases in the produce and meat section begin to pulse as if under a heartbeat: thin, raw-looking membranes unfurl inside trays and the packaged surfaces ripple and weep a viscous red glaze. One aluminum tray tears and slides onto the floor, spilling a tacky residue that starts to move.
consequence: A torn tray leaves a congealed, semi-solid residue that creeps toward the aisle and the earlier oil streak.
nextHook: congealed residue advancing along the floor toward the mall walkway
stillPrompt: Tight three-quarter shot of a row of refrigerated display cases: the glass fogged, metal edges slick. Inside, packaged trays flex and a fabric-like membrane peels back to reveal wet interior folds; droplets bead and run. One tray rips with a metallic whisper and slides to the tile, leaving a shiny, bobbing residue that begins to creep away. Shoppers are out of focus behind the glass. No signage or text.
videoPrompt: Slow dolly along the front of the refrigerated row. Animate the rhythmic pulsing of trays, the membranes peeling back, droplets gathering and a tray tearing free to slide onto the floor. Track the residue as it oozes toward the aisle and joins the previously visible oil path. Keep attention strictly on objects and materials; do not show any additional figures or sculptures.
cameraCue: Low tracking close to the tray edge; follow the torn tray as it slides and leave the camera static as the residue begins to creep.

title: Iridescent Warning
event: The congealed residue reacts: it fizzes and flattens into a thin iridescent film that spreads across the tiles. The film refracts the harsh fluorescents into strobing hazard colors; small plastic safety tags and clipped fasteners tear free from shelves and spin like petals over the film. A localized incandescent point flares where fizz concentrates, scorching the glaze into a circular black ring.
consequence: A perfect round scorch imprint appears on the tile where the film bubbled most intensely.
nextHook: the circular scorch mark on the tile, stained and warm
stillPrompt: Floor-level view: a spreading sheet of iridescent film on store tile, thin rainbow sheens catching and breaking overhead light into frantic bands. Plastic safety tags spin down onto the film and wobble. Near the center a small bright ember appears and burns a clean circular scorch into the floor. No figures or sculptures are present; no readable text.
videoPrompt: Handheld low sweep across the tile as the iridescent film ripples outward and the plastic tags twirl and settle. Animate the fizzing of the residue and the flash of an incandescent bead that leaves the circular scorch. End on the fresh scorch as people and fixtures shift in the background without drawing focus.
cameraCue: A low, slightly jittery push that follows the film to the moment the ember flares and reveals the round scorch.

title: Ordered Panic
event: Shoppers react to the warning-like spectacle with an almost choreographed response: they funnel into ordered chains, moving with the discipline of an evacuation drill. The crowd forms rigid human lanes around the scorch. A small child drops a plush toy; it bounces, slides and comes to rest half-melted against the scorched ring. Security staff form a slow ring and push carts into makeshift barricades.
consequence: A half-melted child's toy sits pressed to the scorch, its fur congealed and its plastic eye clouded.
nextHook: the scorched toy lying against the floor's burned ring
stillPrompt: Mid-shot in the aisle: rows of people moving in synchronized, deliberate lines around the scorch. Their faces are softened by motion blur; bodies form ordered lanes. At the center a small plush toy slides and stops, its fur singed where it touches the black ring. The scene reads as a public response to hazard; no sculptures or creatures appear.
videoPrompt: Crane down from shoulder height to reveal the human patterns forming and the toy sliding into the scorch. Animate the crowd's slow, coordinated movement and the toy's small, final skid. Keep focus on people and the toy; do not introduce any sculptures or unexpected figures.
cameraCue: Start wide to show the ordered crowd, then tighten to follow the toy as it collides with the scorch and settles.

title: Figure at the Center
event: A weathered practical sculpture already occupies the central floor at the beginning of the shot: a seven-foot assemblage of burlap, rusted sheet metal, patched plumbing fittings, hand-stitched seams and ground-in dirt, with mismatched glass marbles inset as eyes and faded cloth draped like a coat. The crowd treats it as a focal threat. Panic cascades: alarms ping, fixtures collapse into jagged chutes, and people surge; a heavy, wet footprint is stamped into the glazed tile beside the scorch as a display falls and slams down.
consequence: A deep, oily footprint stamped into the floor glaze beside the scorch; several displays lie toppled around it.
nextHook: the monster's heavy footprint leading toward checkout and the conveyor system
stillPrompt: Location-reanchored wide shot of the Kaufhaus atrium: the weathered practical sculpture stands inert in the center—burlap, rusted sheet panels, stitched seams, plumbing joints, glass marbles for eyes; it reads as a constructed, weathered prop filmed in the space. Around it a ring of toppled fixtures and a fresh, deep oily footprint beside the scorch. People are in mid-panic, caught around the figure. No readable text or logos.
videoPrompt: From the still start frame where the sculpture is already present, animate the human panic: alarms, collapsing fixture chutes, people surging and security forming a ring. Do not animate an entrance or reveal of the sculpture; keep the figure static aside from minimal settling. Focus motion on people and falling architecture; show a falling display knocking a metal basket which stamps the heavy footprint into the glaze.
cameraCue: After the collapse, drop to a low angle behind the sculpture to reveal the oily footprint and toppled displays in the foreground, the crowd receding in the background.
